During the 1990s he had several drug-related arrests and spent time in treatment and jail. He has described becoming sober in the early 2000s—commonly cited as around 2003—and has credited treatment, support from family, and a sustained recovery program.

“Alcoholic” is a personal/clinical label, but it is fair to say he has openly acknowledged serious addiction issues that included alcohol.
